frozen_on: anchor_dev_v4 only (anchor_val_v4 not yet generated or inspected)

anchor.rationale: consensus has the lowest p99 center error (1.555 vs 1.98) and the fewest misassignments (40); posterior_center is the best non-abstaining fallback (p95 0.333)

patch.rationale: 0.75x ink height keeps glyph containment failures at 1-3% across every ink-height bucket, removing the size dependence that 0.48x still showed (63% at 8-12px vs 5% at 33-44px)

known_cost.note: a wider patch admits more neighbouring ink; a CNN trained on this input must learn to ignore it, which is why v4 requires retraining rather than reusing accent-v3

guard_unknown_conditions: anchor candidates disagree beyond the pitch tolerance
anchor lands nearer a neighbour token than the target
patch clipped by the image edge
CTC sequence does not reconstruct the decoded text
no e/é token emitted at the target position
input preparation fails or the patch is empty
